name: search_entities
description: Find canonical entities for the caller's tenant by entity_type and/or a name/key substring. Structured lookup, NOT semantic vector search (use vector_search for that). Tenant-scoped; no free-form SQL. tenant_id is the requested data scope (authorization handled by the Gateway governance layer).

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose data this operation is scoped to (requested data scope). The Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it.

query.description: Optional substring matched against canonical_key or display_name.

limit.description: Max entities to return, intended range 1..50 (default 50). Upper bound still capped server-side; DEGRADATION: the Gateway no longer enforces the lower bound >=1.
